population_count.description: Null means the legacy response did not record this count; null is never equivalent to zero.

FixtureSelector.description: Supply an exact id or enough team/date information to resolve exactly one fixture. Multiple supplied selectors are conjunctive. Ambiguous requests return candidates and do not call a provider.

event.description: Fixture label such as Brazil vs Morocco.

payPerUse.description: Pay-per-use access. An unpaid call returns 402 Payment Required with a signed challenge; settle it with x402 or MPP and retry.
payPerUse.name: x-payment

info.description: The canonical eleven-route World Cup 2026 storefront contract. The active runtime remains v2; the tested v3 contract is an inactive local publication candidate with the final published FIFA registration snapshot and raw-player reconciliation. Valid archive hits skip legacy work and archive errors fail closed.
info.title: Machina Sports World Cup Intelligence

post.description: Scores the 98 original archived forecasts computed before kickoff against verified 90-minute results, including AET/PEN fixtures through regulation_time_score. Six late forecasts are excluded. CLV and market calibration remain explicitly unsupported. This completed World Cup path is read-only.

200.description: Archive backtest with total, included, excluded, sources, reasons, and track record.

post.description: Archived event truth plus optional enrichment. Ambiguous selectors return candidates instead of an arbitrary fixture.

200.description: Resolved archived event context, or warnings and candidates.

400.description: Missing, invalid, or ambiguous fixture selector.

post.description: Fixture-scoped provider evidence. An empty response does not prove complete historical injury coverage.

200.description: Fixture-scoped injury evidence with coverage caveats.

400.description: Missing, invalid, or ambiguous fixture selector.

post.description: Preserves the stored model probabilities and computed_at timestamp. Reports whether the model predates kickoff; market gaps are suppressed unless the cache is a verifiable historical pre-match quote.

200.description: Stored forecast with forecast and market integrity classifications.

400.description: Missing, invalid, or ambiguous fixture selector.

post.description: Fixture-scoped player evidence with explicit player identity. Official FIFA values remain separate from Machina provisional estimates; ambiguous names return candidates.

200.description: Explicit player context or unavailable/ambiguous evidence status.

400.description: Fixture or player selector is missing, invalid, or ambiguous.

post.description: All 104 archived World Cup 2026 fixtures and final results, filterable by team, opponent, status, and inclusive date range with bounded offset pagination.

200.description: Archived fixture list with canonical and provider ids.

400.description: Invalid date, status, limit, offset, or date range.

post.description: Final World Cup 2026 group tables. An empty body defaults to API-Football league 1 and season 2026.

id.description: Provider id or canonical Machina URN.

post.description: Returns original archived copy with its generation date, historical-perspective annotation, and event references when warmed. A clean miss retains legacy behavior during canary migration; force_regen cannot bypass a valid archive hit.

200.description: Source-annotated archived recap or explicit archive miss.

400.description: Fixture is missing, ambiguous, unknown, or unfinished.

post.description: Source-grounded structured tournament retrospective for every observed provider player. The two original editorial cards are retained separately. Exact provider ids work when no canonical URN is evidenced; force_regen cannot bypass an archive hit.

player_id.description: Exact API-Football player id, including provider-only archived identities.

200.description: Archived original editorial where available plus a source-grounded structured retrospective for every observed provider player.

servers.description: Upstream Machina API used by the ZeroClick catalog importer; not the buyer-facing gateway.

x-publication.manual_gate: Authorized dashboard re-import and post-import verification are required; changing openApiUrl alone does not publish or overwrite the catalog.

x-transport-contract: The 200 schemas describe the workflow's public source response. The external HTTP gateway may wrap it in a transport envelope; that envelope is platform-owned and is not implemented or asserted by this repository.
